# Help EFF Cut the AI Hype

In the global race to build and dominate the AI industry, it can sure seem like the interests of ordinary people sit last on the agenda. It's just the opposite for EFF. While companies furiously jam AI tools into their veins and your eyeballs, EFF’s technologists, activists, and attorneys have been meticulously cutting through the hype to ensure AI can serve your privacy and free expression. Technology has leaned into a new era, and this summer you can help EFF fight for the people.

[JOIN EFF](https://supporters.eff.org/donate/s26--d1)

Over the next two weeks, we’re encouraging you to support the cause as [an EFF member for as little as $10 each month](https://supporters.eff.org/donate/s26--d1). You can get great member swag every year like our privacy puffy stickers, Claw Back t-shirt, and Privacy Badger Crewneck.

Fight mass surveillance! Pictured: Claw Back member t-shirt and Privacy Badger Crewneck.

AI tools—beyond their marketing fluff—demonstrate both incredible potential and real danger. With the support of members around the world, [EFF detangles the possibilities](https://eff.org/ai) from the anxieties and threats with the care and nuance it deserves. In recent months, EFF:

- [Mobilized people against the GUARD Act](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/05/congress-narrowed-guard-act-serious-problems-remain), which would require problematic age verifications systems for AI companions.
- Joined civil society partners to call out a General Services Administration proposal that [would make AI tools less safe and less useful](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/04/tech-nonprofits-feds-dont-weaponize-procurement-undermine-ai-trust-and-safety).
- Sued for answers under the Freedom of Information Act to uncover [how the government is using AI to evaluate requests for medical care](https://www.eff.org/press/releases/eff-sues-answers-about-medicares-ai-experiment).
- [Testified before the U.S. Congress](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/eff-testifies-congress-protecting-americans-rights-government-ai) Homeland Security Subcommittee on Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Protection.

The scope of AI, [both the good and the bad](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/02/smart-ai-policy-means-understanding-its-real-harms-and-benefits), multiplies every day. If we want the AI-powered benefits of efficiency, scientific discovery, and greater accessibility to knowledge, then we also need strong protections against surveillance, harms to creativity and innovation online, perpetuating systemic bias, and privacy violations now.

With AI taking over the public consciousness, you can be assured that EFF will never stop advocating for you. Together, we can ensure that technology supports freedom, justice, and innovation for all people.

[Join EFF](https://supporters.eff.org/donate/s26--d1)

*EFF is a member-supported U.S. 501(c)(3) organization.  We've  received top rati ngs  from the nonprofit watchdog Charity Navigator since 2013!  Your donation is tax-deductible as allowed by law.*

# 協助 EFF 砍掉 AI 炒作

在全球競逐發展與主導人工智慧產業的過程中，普通人的利益似乎總是排在最末。但對電子 frontline foundation (EFF) 而言，情況恰好相反。當企業急著將各種 AI 工具灌進產品時，EFF 的技術專家、活動家和律師們則致力於剖析其中的炒作聲浪，確保人工智慧能保護你的隱私與言論自由。科技已進入新時代，今年夏天你也可以協助 EFF 為人民發聲。

[加入 EFF](https://supporters.eff.org/donate/s26--d1)

在接下來的兩週內，我們鼓勵你以每月 10 美元的費用成為 EFF 會員來支持這項事業（https://supporters.eff.org/donate/s26--d1）。作為會員，你可以每年獲得高品質的周邊商品，例如隱私防護貼紙、隱私反擊 T-shirt 和隱私守門俠連身衣。

AI 工具的潛力遠不止於行銷話術所展示的，它們既有巨大可能性，也存在真實風險。在全球會員的支持下，[EFF 正以謹慎與細膩的方式，將 AI 的可能性與疑慮及威脅分開](https://eff.org/ai)。近年來，EFF：

- [動員群眾對抗 GUARD 法案](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/05/congress-narrowed-guard-act-serious-problems-remain)，該法案要求 AI 伴侶必須採用有問題的年齡驗證系統。
- 與民間團體合作，對國土安全部的提案提出質疑，該提案 [將使 AI 工具變得不安全且無用](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/04/tech-nonprofits-feds-dont-weaponize-procurement-undermine-ai-trust-and-safety)。
- 依據《資訊自由法》提起訴訟，要求政府揭露 [AI 如何被用來評估醫療服務請求](https://www.eff.org/press/releases/eff-sues-answers-about-medicares-ai-experiment)。
- 在美國國會 [作證保護公民權利免受政府 AI 的侵害](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/eff-testifies-congress-protecting-americans-rights-government-ai)，出席了國土安全部網路安全與基礎設施保護小組聽證會。

AI 的範圍，[包括好壞兩面]（https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/02/smart-ai-policy-means-understanding-its-real-harms-and-benefits）每天都在擴大。如果我們想讓 AI 帶來效率提升、科學發現和知識更廣泛的可及性等好處，那麼也必須有強力的保護措施來對抗監控、網路上的創造力與創新傷害、延續系統性偏見以及隱私侵犯。

隨著 AI 深入大眾意識，你可以放心，我們一定會持續為你發聲。攜手合作，確保科技能支持所有人的自由、正義和創新。

[加入 EFF](https://supporters.eff.org/donate/s26--d1)

*EFF 是依美國《非營利機構與慈善機關法》成立的 501(c)(3) 組織，自 2013 年以來在 Charity Navigator 的評鑑中一直獲得最高評級！捐款皆可依法扣稅。*
